steps.en: Clone the skill into your agent's skills directory
steps.zh: 把 skill 克隆进 agent 的 skills 目录

steps.en: Ships SKILL.md plus the pattern catalog it must read before auditing anything
steps.zh: 自带 SKILL.md 和审计前必须先读完的模式目录

steps.en: Hand it a draft, or point it at a prose file
steps.zh: 把草稿交给它，或指定一个 prose 文件
steps.code: remove AI-isms · audit for AI tells

steps.en: Flags matches by pattern and severity, separating real problems from judgment calls
steps.zh: 按模式与严重度列出命中项，区分真问题和判断题

steps.en: Applies up to two passes and stops when no justified in-scope edit remains
steps.zh: 最多做两轮修改，没有正当的范围内改动就停

steps.en: Optionally gate prose in CI or pre-commit
steps.zh: 可选：在 CI 或 pre-commit 里给 prose 设门禁

steps.en: Fails the build when a file's finding count crosses your threshold
steps.zh: 某个文件的命中数超过阈值就让构建失败

steps.en: Returns one final version, a changes summary, and the verification report
steps.zh: 返回唯一一版终稿、改动摘要和验证报告

value.en: One audited final version comes back, with a finding count you can gate in CI instead of a vibe check
value.zh: 拿回唯一一版过了审计的终稿，外加一个能在 CI 里设门禁的命中数，而不是凭感觉

sources: https://github.com/conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing README — Install (git clone … ~/.claude/skills/avoid-ai-writing), trigger phrases, three modes (rewrite/detect/edit), --iterate 1|2 pass ceiling
README — Gate prose in GitHub Actions (uses: conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing@v3.35.0 with glob/threshold/context) and .pre-commit-hooks.yaml
README — npx --package avoid-ai-writing-detector avoid-ai-writing draft.md (runs bin/avoid-ai-writing.js; verified locally: JSON result with score + issues)
SKILL.md frontmatter + reference-loading note requiring references/patterns.md in full (size verified locally: 103,947 bytes)
corpus/README.md and PROOF.md — self-measured false-positive table and the CI-gated self-scan (verified locally: node scripts/self-scan.js, node scripts/run-tests.js → 20 passed)
